name: frontier-audit
description: Score repositories against The Machine's conformance kit and optionally issue signed AAR evidence receipts via the published @frontier-infra/audit CLI.

interface.longDescription: Score a repository against The Machine's conformance kit, bind the result to its Git state, and optionally issue a signed AAR evidence receipt. Runs the published @frontier-infra/audit CLI via npx; the evidence packet records the exact CLI version that produced it. Receipts distinguish structural verifier separation from organizational independence and default to same-principal attestation, not third-party audit.
defaultPrompt: Use Frontier Audit to audit and attest this repository.
Run an evidence-bound audit with the published Frontier Audit CLI.
